Performance Location: U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, 15100 Rescue Way,

1. General Notice & Acquisition Overview 
This document constitutes a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services and minor 
facility improvements prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation 
(FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. 
Sole Solicitation: This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being 
requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 
Set-Aside: This solicitation is advertised as a 100% Total Small Business Set-Aside. 
Offers received from entities other than small business concerns under NAICS code 
238330 will not be considered. 
Basis of Award: Award will be made using simplified acquisition procedures to the 
responsible offeror whose quote conforms to all solicitation requirements and represents 
the Best Value to the Government, considering technical capability/approach, past 
performance, and price. 

 2. Schedule of Supplies / Services & Pricing 
The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, tools, transportation, 
disposal, and incidental services necessary to complete the carpet replacement project as 
specified in the Statement of Work.

Site Access Rules: Only U.S. citizens and permanent resident aliens are allowed onboard 
Air Station Clearwater. Attendees must present valid government photo identification at the 
front gate. Vehicles and equipment are subject to inspection at all times. 

 4. Statement of Work (SOW) — Project 33643384 
4.1 Scope of Work Summary 
The Contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, tools, equipment, materials, delivery, furniture 
moving, carpet and cove base removal, surface preparation, installation, cleanup, and disposal for 
the complete replacement of existing carpet and cove base throughout designated administrative 
areas within the FACENG and Supply building. All work must comply with the Carpet and Rug 
Institute (CRI) 104 Standard for Installation of Commercial Carpet, manufacturer written 
instructions, and applicable federal, state, and local standards. 
4.2 Included Areas and Approximate Takeoffs 
FACENG and Conference Areas: Rooms 115, 116, 119, 122, former Room 114 suite 
(conference room, adjoining office, and internal passages): approximately 1,150 sq. ft. 
Supply Office Areas: Rooms 102, 103, 104, 107, 108, 109, and 110: approximately 1,670 
sq. ft. 
Combined Planning Takeoff: Approximately 2,820 square feet of carpet tile and 775 
linear feet of cove base. 
Excluded Areas: Hard-floor supply warehouse, public corridors/vestibules, main lobby, 
restrooms, mechanical rooms, and shop floors. 
Period of Performance: Total period of performance shall be forty-five (45) calendar 
days from issuance of the Notice to Proceed (NTP). 
Schedule Submission: The Contractor shall provide a phased, room-by-room work 
schedule outlining start dates, sequence, weekend milestones, and completion 

 4.4 Technical Requirements & Material Specifications 
1. Carpet Tile: Commercial-grade, heavy/severe-traffic-rated modular carpet tiles equal to or 
exceeding existing durability and aesthetic standards. Materials must originate from 
consistent production runs/dye lots within each contiguous area. 
2. Cove Base: Commercial resilient cove base matching existing height (minimum nominal 
height of 4 inches). 
3. Submittals & Approval: Prior to material ordering, the Contractor must submit product 
technical data, adhesive specifications, color lines, transition details, and manufacturer 
warranty certificates to the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR). The COR will select 
final colors and patterns. 
4. Subfloor Preparation: Remove old adhesive residue, perform mechanical scraping, patch 
cracks/depressions, and verify moisture and pH levels
